definitions.ack: Inner create/update pipeline interval from start_time to build_commit_receipt; not HTTP acknowledgement time.
definitions.gate_wait: The current native receipt explicitly sets this field to zero; no actual gate-wait measurement.
definitions.http_minus_inner_receipt_us: Signed HTTP duration minus the inner receipt interval. It includes work outside that interval, not a measured fsync or transport phase.
definitions.inner_receipt_minus_prepare_us: Signed inner receipt interval minus preparation. It includes other work inside that interval, not a measured disk, CPU or gate phase.
definitions.percentiles: Nearest rank p95 over original samples; p50 is the median. Units are microseconds.
definitions.prepare: Elapsed schema delta preparation plus related molecule rebase/fold; includes awaited work, not CPU alone.
definitions.publish: The current native receipt has no recording site for this field; zero does not prove no publication cost.

limitations: Receipt clocks overlap; do not sum prepare, ack, gate_wait and publish into an HTTP-time partition.
Derived differences are arithmetic residuals, not direct measurements of disk, CPU or gate waits.
File-barrier durations cover status endpoints, can overlap threads and include later baseline notices; do not subtract them from request latency.
Concurrent host jobs prevent isolated or causal speed claims.
The driver did not capture detailed request_ops phase timings; absent phases remain unavailable, not zero.

receipt_clock_scope.current_mini_create_update: commit_native_request awaits its owning transaction::request_scope, which waits for the queued disk sequence before build_commit_receipt stamps ack. The inspected Mini routes add no enclosing native transaction.
receipt_clock_scope.disk_proof: The whole HTTP reply waits for the required local commit. Neither the inner clock nor HTTP-minus-inner time isolates physical file barrier cost.
receipt_clock_scope.inherited_native_scope: request_scope returns future.await when PendingBatch::current exists. An inner receipt can then precede an outer scope durable wait; the ack field has no universal disk-completion boundary.
receipt_clock_scope.mixed_and_pure_erasure: Mixed requests retain the create/update clock before later erasure phases. Pure erasure receipts use default stage clocks. These forms are outside this paired create/update matrix.
receipt_clock_scope.outside_the_clock: Earlier route and admission work, later capture/attribution work, receipt logs, response construction and transport can fall outside the inner receipt interval.
